summary: Keep GitHub observer refusals on real cooldowns and distinguish local observer budgets

replay.detail: Repeated provider refusals persist their latest next-check deadline instead of retaining the first reset. Existing observer claims remain readable; no replay or backfill is required.

schema.detail: Observer and watch state enums and wire fields are unchanged. A separate optional budget-history JSON sidecar retains bounded 48-hour resource-specific provider header samples; the authoritative admission ledger is unchanged.

rules.detail: Only future GitHub Retry-After/reset deadlines are accepted; absent a future deadline, primary and secondary limits wait fifteen minutes. The per-daemon observer cap is unchanged and is classified as a local refusal, not GitHub HTTP 429. Each same-origin REST redirect hop is separately admitted; cross-origin redirects are refused, and implicit transport retries are disabled in observer and authorized gateway clients.

compatibility.detail: N/N-1 compatibility uses existing wire values: local admission emits observer state healthy with existing string error_code local-observer-budget, reason and next_check_unix_ms; watch state remains active and its existing reason says throttled. This does not record a successful provider observation or replace resource facts. Inspected 62086f3b source evidence: crates/fractal-schema/src/lib.rs:3389-3398 permits healthy and defines reason/error_code/next_check_unix_ms as strings; fractal-github-base/src/github_watch.rs:865,876-879 uses active and an existing string reason. No new enum or response field reaches daemon replay, TUI, web or client-v0 decoders. Healthy is used only because fractal-store/src/store/attention_snapshot.rs:975 skips healthy, but :983-984 maps degraded to Rejected, which always raises owner attention. Diagnostic history is ignored by older binaries.

manual.detail: No live config changes or reader-capability rollout needed: observer/watch wire vocabularies are unchanged. The cap remains per daemon, not fleet-wide.

recovery.detail: Ordinary rollback keeps the existing wire states, string defer metadata and deadline readable; the diagnostic budget sidecar does not control admission and is ignored by older binaries.
